<!-- Generated by docs-kit refgen/help2md from --help output. Do not edit. -->

```text
List the remote cache's generations with the verdict `gc` would apply

Usage: kasha ls [OPTIONS] --remote <REMOTE>

Options:
      --remote <REMOTE>
          Remote cache as s3://bucket?endpoint=…&region=… (read-only creds suffice) [env: KASHA_REMOTE=]
      --main-keep <MAIN_KEEP>
          Keep the N newest `main` generations per group [default: 5]
      --main-age-weeks <MAIN_AGE_WEEKS>
          Also keep `main` generations younger than this many weeks [default: 4]
      --other-keep <OTHER_KEEP>
          Keep the N newest non-`main` generations per group [default: 1]
      --other-age-weeks <OTHER_AGE_WEEKS>
          Also keep non-`main` generations younger than this many weeks [default: 1]
      --stale-weeks <STALE_WEEKS>
          Drop a group's count-retained generations once its newest one trails the newest of its flake's tier (main or other) by this many weeks; 0 disables [default: 4]
  -h, --help
          Print help
```
